changes.description: Migrated to self-hosted deployment on a home lab server with automated CI/CD pipeline.
Implemented secure public exposure via Cloudflare Tunnel with no open inbound ports.
Established GitHub Actions workflow for automatic Docker image builds and homelab deployments on every master push.
Containerized the application with Docker Compose, healthchecks, and a dedicated non-root runtime user.
Redesigned the /language-services page with a bento-style services grid featuring icons, accent borders, and hover interactions.
Added an interactive left-rail timeline to the /language-services Experience section with a scroll-tracking fill indicator and a floating year pill.
Grouped experience items by year in the /language-services timeline with proportional segment heights and visual gaps between years.
Fixed mobile Navbar menu icons not displaying correctly in the hamburger menu.
Updated the Kharidian Dunes theme palette for improved contrast and visual consistency.
Typography pass across all pages: standardised H1 to text-4xl font-bold font-serif on /blog, /blog/[slug], /dev, /portfolio/[slug], /language-services, and /contact.

Fixed semantic HTML in /language-services: client name labels were incorrectly using

tags; changed to

with font-bold styling. 'Experience' section heading changed from

to

.
Added font-semibold to all heading levels in HeadingAnchor component used in blog and portfolio post content.
Redesigned blog post cards and project cards: each card is now fully clickable, slightly narrower (w-80), with increased gap between cards for a more spacious layout.
Added a right-arrow indicator to card CTAs to reinforce interactivity.
Blog post cards now show a local placeholder image when no post image is available, matching the existing behaviour of project cards.
Featured project cards on the home page now correctly show the placeholder image when no project image is declared, instead of a white box.

Added full CI/CD deployment pipeline: multi-stage Dockerfile (standalone output), docker-compose with Cloudflare Tunnel sidecar, and GitHub Actions workflows for build/push to GHCR and deploy to self-hosted homelab runner.
Added a monthly maintenance reminder workflow that automatically opens a GitHub issue with a checklist of routine site maintenance tasks.
Replaced Unsplash external fallback image with a local placeholder at /images/assets/placeholder.png used across all cards and as the default Open Graph image.
Fixed toAbsoluteUrl() to always return a fully qualified URL, preventing relative paths in Open Graph metadata.
Added /portfolio/[slug] static route with full project detail pages, generated at build time for all published projects.
Added redirect from /portfolio to /dev to avoid 404s on the old portfolio URL.
SITE_URL is now driven by the NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL environment variable with a fallback, making the app domain-agnostic and ready for deployment to any host.
Added .env.example documenting all required environment variables.
Fixed .gitignore to allow .env.example to be committed while still ignoring all real .env files.
Hero profile image now served from public/ directory instead of being bundled into the JavaScript output.
Made some adjustements to the blog post page to ensure that the hero image is always displayed if available, and falls back to a default image if not.
Fixed up typing issues between Contentlayer and the renderer in the blog post page.
Added h-20 to the Footer component to make it consistent with the Navbar.
Finally fleshed out the /language-servies page to include more details about the services I offer and my experience in the field.
Overhaul of several color themes to improve contrast and readability.
Removed some off-theme styling effects to keep the design clean and consistent.
Fixed the broken Navbar that would flicker on scroll while on smaller screens.
Redesigned the /blog and /dev views for a cleaner and more minimalistic look.
Fixed the broken palette drawer padding issues on larger screens.
Redesigned the /blog and /dev views for a cleaner and more minimalistic look.
Fixed the broken palette drawer padding issues on larger screens.
Cleaned up the /blog view to be clean and minimalistic so I can move on to the /dev view.
Refactored types for the headers that handle themes/cookies, etc.
Build on the `/blog` route to display the (for now) dummy data in card format.
Updated some colors to make for better visibility/separation, and added a divider to the Archive section.
Added the Changelog system to track updates made to the website and display them in `/dev` dynamically.
Updated border color for theme palettes to improve visibility.
Updated palette border styles for better visibility.
Corrected footer copyright year to start from 2020.
Began work on the Changelog system which will track updates made to the website and display them in `/dev`.
Added a theme selector with a range of WoW and OSRS inspired color palettes.
Enhanced theme application logic for better performance.
